original_test_intent: Validate every listed SMBIOS Type 15 System Event Log metadata field and descriptor against the approved platform recipe and prove the structure remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Preserve existing logs, collect complete raw and decoded Type 15 structures on the verified SUT, validate lengths/offsets/access/status/change-token/header/descriptor invariants and expected values, reboot with approval, then repeat and compare persistence.
manual_activity: The owner supplies Type 15 semantics/expected values and approves the reboot; an operator supervises workload safety and recovery while complete collection/comparison is automated.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, platform recipe, BIOS/SMBIOS and dmidecode identities
Expected Type 15 Log Area Length, header/data offsets and bounds rules
Access Method/Address, Log Status, Change Token and Header Format expectations
Descriptor count, per-descriptor length, ordered type/format list and reserved-value policy
Approved reboot method, workload window, boot deadline and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Preserve dmesg, syslog and SEL because clearing destroys relevant baseline evidence
Keep Type 15 and event-log collection read-only; never alter firmware, SMBIOS, SEL or access state
Protect access addresses, change tokens and platform metadata in controlled evidence
Use secure credentials and verified host identity
Require reboot approval and stop on wrong target, failed recovery, malformed bounds or unexpected metadata drift
No automatic reboot or collection retry after ambiguity
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, expected matrix, parser and approved reboot inputs
Collect complete raw Type 15 and parse every listed field and descriptor
Validate offset/length/count arithmetic and compare approved values
Perform only one authorized reboot and repeat same-target collection
Preserve logs and make no mutation, automatic retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Type 15 field/descriptor values and interpretation of status/change token
Review any structural or persistence deviation and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 15` is relevant, but `grep -A1` drops nearly every field explicitly required by the Procedure and does not perform the before/after reboot comparison; the SSH options are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely collect complete `dmidecode -t 15` stdout/stderr and exit status before and after the approved reboot and parse all fixed fields plus exactly x descriptors of length y.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All eleven listed Type 15 metadata/descriptor groups, recipe correctness, reboot persistence, source script and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: PACKAGE-GATED COMPLETE TYPE 15 STRUCTURAL AND REBOOT VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Hash complete raw captures, parse fixed fields and descriptor payloads with bounds checks, compare against the expected matrix and pre/post state, and preserve related logs untouched.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Implements the full explicit field list, structural arithmetic and persistence requirement without destructive log clearing or filtered evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A header-only snippet cannot reveal invalid offsets, mismatched descriptor count/length, unsupported type list, changed token/status or out-of-bounds log layout.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some status or change-token fields may legitimately change when firmware records an event or reboot. The owner must define stable versus dynamic fields rather than requiring blind byte equality.

project_override_considerations: Platform-specific descriptor ordering or dynamic-token allowances must be versioned for the exact BIOS/SMBIOS recipe and remain visible in the field-level diff; structural bounds cannot be waived.
expected_evidence: Verified SUT/recipe/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode identity and approved Type 15 matrix
Complete raw/decoded pre-reboot fixed fields, offset/length bounds and all descriptors
Approved reboot/boot timeline with same-target proof
Complete post-reboot output and stable/dynamic field-level comparison
Preserved dmesg/syslog/SEL, no-clear/no-write/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently define a Type 15 metadata/descriptor comparison across reboot. The DeepSeek filter is incomplete but does not create an alternate source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Expected values, dynamic-field policy and reboot approval are normal package/user inputs; they gate execution but not static review.

review_improvement: Preserves every named Type 15 field while adding structural bounds, descriptor cardinality, stable-versus-dynamic semantics and non-destructive evidence controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 15 validity depends on relationships among fields, not just their presence: header/data offsets must fit within Log Area Length, and the descriptor area must contain exactly the declared number of entries at the declared length. A visible `System Event Log` heading cannot establish those invariants. Log Status or Change Token may also move because of the reboot, so the expected matrix must distinguish allowed monotonic/dynamic behavior from prohibited layout drift.
